'''Gravy''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was added to various dishes.<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served [[Quor'sav-fried steak]] smothered in [[white dwarf gravy]], [[proteinloaf]] covered in [[brown dwarf gravy]], and [[Gamorrean pork chop]] with [[snoruuk gravy]]. As a breakfact side, the diner also offered a [[blue buttermilk biscuit]] and gravy. The diner's menu also claimed that in a pinch its brown dwarf gravy could be used as an industrial&ndash;strength [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gravy appeared in [[1998]] novel ''[[I, Jedi]]'' written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]].<ref name="I Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
